description.narrative: The SAGCOT Centre Ltd (SCL) is a public-private partnership (PPP) that seeks to develop the Tanzanian agricultural sector by fostering responsible agribusiness investments in the country’s Southern Corridor. SCL works as a broker and catalyst in forming partnerships among registered organizations. The aim is to incubate initiatives that promote inclusive, sustainable and viable agricultural value chains. SCL’s mission is to be an honest facilitator of relationships between the government, agro-industries, SMEs, small and medium-scale farmers, and other stakeholder. SCL’s vision is to transform Tanzania’s agricultural sector in a manner that agro-industries are inclusive of small and medium-scale farmers and are environmentally sustainable. The strategy places emphasis on cluster development through the commodity compact model, optimizing value chains, and building climate resilience adapting to the changing climate. SCL targets women and youth in operations and policy work.
